verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own card issuance: "Issue debit cards worldwide" and a card-order API to create cards. Physical cards are implied by kiosk printing and by spend permissions for ATM, contactless and magnetic stripe, with MCC/currency spend controls on top. However, the card APIs are framed as Wise Platform partners issuing cards to their customers, not a finance lead issuing cards to employees. Missing for 10: evidence of issuing cards to employees or team members, role-based team permissions, credit card options, explicit physical-card ordering for business employees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
